name: Windows Audit User Account Management (Success and Failure)
description:
Ensures the advanced audit policy subcategory 'User Account Management' records success and failure events. Parsed from the English-language auditpol output.
Required Windows permission: LEA agent account must be allowed to run only: auditpol /get /category:* (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.
